integrity: A direct structural proof establishes the lower bound and uniquely determines the seven-vertex obstruction. An exhaustive standard-library verifier independently enumerates all connected labeled graphs through seven vertices, recomputes core numbers by two formulations on every first failure, and verifies the complete relabeling orbit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns connected finite simple undirected graphs, requires a unique maximum-degree vertex, and classifies only the first order at which that vertex can be excluded from the innermost core. It does not identify actual influence under a dynamical spreading model and makes no larger-order frequency claim.
title: The unique first peripheral hub outside the innermost core
